thread:
Alex Chen: Quick sync from the postmortem — we shipped the hotfix but there are follow-ups: we need owners + timelines for remediation, and a runbook polish for the eviction cascade we saw.
Maya Patel: I can take runbook edits. Will add clearer triage steps and the exact commands we ran during the incident.
Ben Ortiz: Thanks Maya. Can you include the KV cache checks and the `kubectl` commands for pod-level diagnostics? e.g.:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs svc-inference-0 -c inference | tail -n 200
```
Also add the eviction signals to the checklist (OOMKill, node pressure).
Sienna Ko: I'll own remediation work to reduce eviction frequency. Proposed timeline: quick spike this week to adjust cache TTLs + batching heuristics, then a 2-week remediation sprint for more robust eviction resistance. Target: spike by Thu, sprint start Monday.
Alex Chen: Sounds good. Can you paste the spike plan here when ready? I want to sync with Dedicated infra since autoscaler config might need changes.
Maya Patel: On runbook content — suggested triage flow: 1) confirm incident scope (routes/models), 2) check node metrics, 3) check KV cache hit/miss, 4) warm fallback model, 5) escalate to SRE lead if >2 nodes evicted. I'll add the short commands and a canned message for oncall.
Ben Ortiz: Add the escalation path with exact Slack steps and who to page. For example:
- If degradation > 10% P99 or >2 pods evicted -> page @sre-oncall and @infra-lead
- If capacity exhausted -> open runbook incident and fallback to smaller model
Sienna Ko: For remediation owners: Sienna -> batching/cache tuning (spike + sprint), Ben -> runbook checklist + automation to detect early eviction, Maya -> publish runbook PR and coordinate docs review. I'll put actual due dates in the ticket.
DevOps Bot: Reminder: created ticket #INF-4921 for "Eviction cascade remediation" and assigned Sienna, Ben, Maya as watchers.
Alex Chen: Please add a short postmortem-linked eval that watches model quality after fallback routes are used — we saw one regression during the event.
Maya Patel: Will add an eval + success criteria (no >1% drop in BLEU/ROUGE for the next 2 deploys). Also adding a rollback recipe and a canary gate for the autoscaler changes.
Ben Ortiz: I'll update the runbook PR with a 'common fixes' section (commands, why the fix works) and a one-click checklist for oncall to run.
Sienna Ko: Spike plan posted: tweak cache TTLs to 30s, reduce burst batch size from 64->48 for pod-level safety, run load test Friday 10:00 PT. If green, schedule sprint kickoff Monday.
Alex Chen: Great — owners and rough timeline captured. Action items to create in tracker: 1) Runbook PR (Maya) by Fri, 2) Spike + load test (Sienna) by Fri load test, 3) Automation alert (Ben) by next Wed. Please update tickets and mark blockers.
Maya Patel: I'll open the runbook PR this afternoon, link to the postmortem, and add the triage script snippet.
Ben Ortiz: I'll draft the alert rules and post the PATTERN match queries in the runbook so oncall can see what triggers the new page.
Sienna Ko: I'll post load test results and a short summary in the ticket thread. If anything looks off I'll escalate earlier.
Alex Chen: Thanks team. Quick follow-up: let's do a 15-min sync after the spike (Fri 11:30 PT) to decide sprint scope. Adding calendar invite now. :thumbsup:
